answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A cipher of per-task receipts records who did what, and the mirror of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The vertex of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
